CustomField.description: 12/17/20: removed One or more SKUs missing type criteria per case 00059475 06/13/21: Added Training Contact missing criteria INC0135789. Any issues with the Training POC or email, please ensure that the DLRS "Training Product for Approval" is active.
CustomField.formula:
IF(Training_Products__c>0, IF(ISBLANK(SBQQ__Opportunity2__r.Customer_Training_Point_of_Contact__c),"Training POC and Email Missing on the Opportunity;",""),"")&
IF( !ISBLANK( Deal_Desk_Approver__c ),""," Deal Desk Approver; ") &
IF( !ISBLANK( Legal_Entity__c ),""," Legal Entity Missing; ") &
IF(Requestor_Notes_Updated__c = True,""," Incomplete Discount Reason; ") &
IF( !ISBLANK( Text( Focus_Round__c)),""," Focus Round; ")&
IF( Quote_Has_Lines__c = FALSE, "Add Products; ","") &
IF( ABS( Net_Total_Billing__c - SBQQ__NetAmount__c) = 0,""," Billing Amounts must equal Net Total; ") &
IF( !ISBLANK( SBQQ__BillingName__c ),""," Billing Name; ")&
IF(SBQQ__PricebookId__c <>"01s0e000000NxxjAAC" && ESR_Product_Count__c > 0,
IF( SBQQ__Opportunity2__r.ESO_Approved__c =False, "ESO Request is not Approved",""),"")&
IF(Onsite_TAM_Count__c >0, IF( SBQQ__Opportunity2__r.ESO_Approved__c =False, "ESO Request is not Approved",""),"")&
IF(ISBLANK( AreaVP__c ), "Area VP;","")
CustomField.inlineHelpText: If there is anything listed in this field, Salesforce will prevent you from submitting your quote and you will get an error. Visit the Deal Desk Gsite for assistance.
CustomField.label: Missing for Submission
